about: One entry per AI run. 'file' is the raw answer file; tools/build.py turns these into data/responses.json for the page. Add a new model by running it cold (tools/run_headless.sh or the app) and adding an entry here.

runs.caveat: Started inside Jaron's project, so it also read the project's instruction file (which says limits belong in scripts, with bold work inside them). Its Prompt 2 answer echoes that line. Not a fully cold read.
